images.title: 整体风格板
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game art-direction style board, image 01 of a coherent six-image presentation.
Primary request: design a beautiful, polished visual identity for the Chinese electricity construction / management / history-teaching game "潮汐电网" (TIDAL GRID). Direction is an exquisite physical miniature coastal diorama, with a refined modern control-desk interface. This is a NEW art redesign with much better modeling than primitive boxes.
Canvas and composition: landscape 16:9, crisp editorial art-direction board, carefully aligned on a very dark marine-blue background. Upper-left title, a large hero miniature coastal island occupying the upper-right half; lower half contains a row of six individually framed small facility studies and a compact UI component sample, with generous spacing. Hierarchy: beautiful scene first, tangible materials second, concise visual UI grammar third.
World style: orthographic isometric 3D miniature architectural models, finely chamfered edges, substantial matte ceramic / painted plaster / pale concrete surfaces, delicately molded roof seams, limited brushed copper details, rich teal roofs, cream walls, muted terracotta accents, blue solar glass, warm amber window light. A sculpted irregular rocky shoreline, pale sand, carefully shaped trees, a lighthouse and modest harbour. Soft warm afternoon key light with gentle cool marine fill, convincing contact shadows, detailed but legible silhouettes. The landscape is hopeful, handcrafted, coastal, sophisticated and approachable.
Facility studies: a cream house with teal pitched roof; elegant three-blade wind turbine; angled photovoltaic array; electrical substation with transformer and open busbars; three-cabinet battery station; nineteenth-century brick dynamo hall with visible brass flywheel. Each is a distinctive miniature on a low chamfered base, same isometric camera and soft shadow.
Design language: deep navy teal #112b35 surfaces, cream white #f2eddb type, mint #77dbc0 electricity / primary actions, amber #efbb7d caution, coral #f38a79 shortage. Show five small unlabeled swatches and three material samples. Flat, finely bordered rounded UI cards, restrained thin line icons, obvious selected / normal / disabled button differences; no neon sci-fi glow. Compact sample component includes one mint action button, one quiet secondary button and an accessible status badge.
Text (verbatim Chinese, use only this concise text): "潮汐电网", subtitle "海湾微缩模型 · 整体风格", section labels "场景与光照", "设施造型", "材质与色彩", "界面语言", button "开启战役", secondary button "设置", status "已接网", bottom caption "概念参考 · 非实机画面".
Constraints: coherent premium game art bible; all facilities built in the same visual world. No photography, no computer monitor mockup, no characters, no stock assets, no watermark, no imaginary logo marks. Never use photorealistic proportions that make the models unreadable. Avoid huge blank space, muddy darkness, tiny illegible paragraphs, noisy textures, glossy plastic, holograms, bloom, decorative circuitry and generic SaaS dashboard styling.

images.title: 主菜单 · 黄昏海湾
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: complete main-menu game screen, image 02 in a six-image art-direction set for the original Chinese game 潮汐电网.
Input image role: the provided image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its finely crafted physical miniature coastal world, cream / dark teal / copper palette, convincing matte materials and elegant navy interface. Create a new main-menu composition, do not copy the reference board layout.
Canvas: landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge game screen. Full-bleed exquisite bay miniature at blue hour / sunset. A dramatically beautiful inhabited coastal town occupies the right 65% of the image; left 35% is calm deep-sea blue negative space for beautifully composed navigation. No visible gameplay HUD or background spreadsheet.
World: orthographic isometric miniature, sophisticated softened geometric forms and chamfered architecture, warm ivory houses with deep teal roofs, lit harbour and lighthouse, articulated electrical substation, three-blade wind turbines, photovoltaic arrays, battery cabinets, restrained power lines with subtle mint routes. The shoreline is sculptural, detailed and irregular, with tiny piers and a few boats. Sunset gold along the horizon, navy ocean, warm window lights becoming visible, cool soft fill for clear silhouettes. Warm, hopeful, quietly cinematic. No characters, no glossy plastic or cartoon mobile-game style.
UI composition: oversized elegant cream Chinese title at upper left with small spaced English subtitle "TIDAL GRID"; below it a tasteful thin gold rule. A restrained tall menu stack with ONE broad mint primary button. Under that button a compact progress summary with a tiny chapter miniature and fine outline. Secondary menu entries are quiet, airy and generously spaced, no giant enclosing modal. A small featured campaign card near the lower edge says 电流的足迹 and has a warm paper inset, timeline dots and a restrained archive stamp. Bottom left includes discreet version text; bottom right a tiny concept caption.
Palette: #112b35 navy, #f2eddb cream, #77dbc0 mint, #efbb7d amber, #f38a79 coral. Use a refined distinctive display serif for the game title only, highly legible Chinese sans serif for all functional navigation and data. Meaningful, consistent thin-line icons.
Text (verbatim, do not invent extra paragraphs): "潮汐电网", "TIDAL GRID", "继续游戏", "教学战役 · 第 03 章", "工厂的清晨", "开启教学战役", "经营路线", "自由沙盘", "设置", "制作名单", "退出游戏", "电流的足迹", "15 个历史现场", "概念参考 · 非实机画面".
Avoid: stacked generic web cards, bright neon, tiny dense text, repeated menu buttons, giant translucent panel hiding the world, photorealistic modern metropolis, watermarks. Make this a polished PC strategy game main menu with a memorable image and clear interaction hierarchy.

images.title: 设置 · 显示与声音
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.

Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the supplied board's refined handcrafted coastal miniature, cream / teal / copper materials, navy interface and tasteful typography. Do not repeat the style-board layout.
Canvas: landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge PC game settings screen. A softly defocused dusk bay miniature fills the background, darkened enough for excellent legibility. A carefully composed broad navy settings surface sits with comfortable screen margins. It is a premium game interface, not a generic enterprise form.
Layout: large tasteful heading upper left, small back control upper right; narrow left navigation with five categories and restrained line icons, first category selected in mint. Center-left primary content shows a clean display settings section with five spacious rows and fine separators, not a box around every row: window mode selector, resolution selector, three segmented scale buttons with 125% selected, VSync toggle on, frame cap selector. At the far right is a deliberate sound-component demonstration panel labeled 声音, containing five sleek horizontal sliders with circular handles, clear numeric percentages and two compact sound-test buttons. This is a unified art-direction preview of display and sound components, all clearly legible.
Materials and UI: navy #112b35 with subtly raised dark teal surfaces, warm cream #f2eddb text, mint #77dbc0 selected controls, amber #efbb7d warnings. Fine pale borders, soft corner radii, generous spacing, polished consistent control states, no bloom. Display title may use the reference's distinctive Chinese display serif; all settings labels, values and buttons MUST use a crisp modern Chinese sans-serif.
Footer: a discreet saved checkmark with 设置自动保存 on the left; quiet 恢复本页默认 and primary 完成 on the right. Settings are immediately saved, so DO NOT include an Apply button. Tiny concept caption.

images.title: 日间经营 · 新场景与建造界面
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: full-screen daytime gameplay concept, image 05 of six, for the Chinese electricity construction and management game 潮汐电网.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the exquisite physical coastal miniatures, matte cream buildings, dark teal roofs, soft chamfers, sophisticated warm lighting and navy/mint interface in the supplied image. Make a NEW playable-map composition, not another style board or main menu.
Canvas: landscape 16:9, polished 2.5D orthographic isometric PC strategy game screenshot. The visible playable map occupies about 75% of the composition. A generous coastal town spreads across gently sculpted flatter terraces, with a clearly readable construction area. The world must be believable as a buildable grid game, not just a tiny unplayable mountainous ornamental island. Irregular rocky shore and turquoise water, a small harbour, neatly placed homes and a modest hospital, a brick industrial park, wind turbine, solar arrays, substation and battery storage, connecting power lines. Warm morning sunlight and soft marine fill; refined modeled roofs, windows and equipment; clear silhouettes, restrained details and believable contact shadows. Fine placement grid ONLY near the active construction patch.
Palette: deep sea navy #112b35 UI, cream #f2eddb text, mint #77dbc0 electric supply / primary actions, amber #efbb7d attention, coral #f38a79 shortage. No excessive neon cable bloom. Functional labels and numeric text in crisp Chinese sans serif, generous sizes. The title can match the reference's display serif but MUST remain small in gameplay.
Slim top status rail, clear hierarchy and restrained height, exact texts: "潮汐电网", "已供 21.8 / 需求 24.0 MW", "缺口 2.2 MW", "资金 ¥248,600", "净收益 +¥1,860 /h", "第 3 天 09:20". Supply bar is mostly mint with a SMALL coral shortfall segment of approximately 9%. Do not invent inconsistent percentages.
Upper-left modest objective card: "当前目标", "稳住昼夜供电". Sparse map callout on the industrial park: "工业园 · 供电不足".
Bottom construction tray with five attractive thumbnails rendered from the same refined models, labels "燃气", "风电", "光伏", "电池", "变电站". 电池 is selected with mint edge. A translucent mint VALID battery placement ghost is visible in an empty flat grid cell, not already built, with clear separation from occupied cells. Compact tool navigation "建造", "经营", "运维", "发展". Small speed controls "暂停", "1×", "3×", "8×".
A small lower-right battery build-information card reads "电池储能", "功率 6 MW", "容量 24 MWh", "建造 ¥18,000", "单击空地放置", "右键取消". Do not add a confirmation modal or hide the map.
Tiny footer "概念预览 · 示例数据".
Avoid full-height spreadsheets, oversized HUD, giant header titles, cluttered map markers, opaque overlays covering the town, primitive boxes, photorealistic city scaling, toy plastic gloss, watermarks. This is a warm, beautiful, genuinely legible strategy-game art redesign.

images.title: 夜间风暴 · 诊断与现场队
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: full-screen night-storm gameplay concept, image 06 of six, for 潮汐电网.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the supplied board's finely crafted coastal physical miniature models, cream and dark teal materials, soft chamfers, sophisticated navy/mint UI and memorable architectural identity. Make a NEW playable-map night emergency scene, not a style board.
Canvas: landscape 16:9. A 2.5D orthographic isometric coastal game map occupies about 70% of the screen; a single elegant diagnosis / field-team workspace occupies the right 30%. Dense-enough buildable town, modest terraces, clear roads and electrical routes, residential district, hospital, industrial plant, substation, batteries and wind turbines. Deep blue night with warm occupied windows and amber streetlights, gentle cool ambient fill so every important building and line remains readable. Controlled diagonal rain, distant storm clouds and limited wet-road highlights. No near-black terrain, lightning glare, large fog, or dense rain curtain.
UI: navy #112b35, cream #f2eddb, mint #77dbc0 confirmed supply/progress, amber #efbb7d uncertain attention, coral #f38a79 confirmed urgent problems. Crisp modern Chinese sans serif for functional UI, thin borders and disciplined hierarchy. Slim top status rail reads exactly: "潮汐电网", "已供 18.6 / 需求 26.0 MW", "缺口 7.4 MW", "风暴持续中", "第 4 天 21:40". Supply bar is about 72% mint / 28% coral.
Evidence on map: a SINGLE known western cable segment has a restrained coral solid marker with "线路 07 · 已核实". The eastern neighborhood is ONLY outlined as a broad amber area with an outlined question-mark badge, label "东岸供电异常 · 待核实". Do NOT draw any precisely failed cable, sparks, damaged equipment or a red fault marker inside this uncertain district. A small public customer-feedback label near the hospital reads "医院报告停电".
Right workspace, heading "供电诊断". A confirmed card with solid coral/cream indicator reads "已核实", "线路 07 故障", "来源：可信遥测". A separate uncertainty card with amber outlined icon reads "待核实", "东岸用户报告停电", "原因尚未确认", with outlined action "派遣巡检".
Below is "现场队" with two clean horizontal real-work bars and labels: "抢修队 A · 线路 07", "62%"; "巡检队 B · 东岸街区", "35%". Progress indicates accepted repair/patrol work, never a guessed precise fault. Small mint link "查看队列与回执".
Compact bottom navigation "建造", "经营", "运维", "发展" and speed controls. Tiny footer "概念预览 · 示例数据".
Render Chinese text accurately and generously; no walls of text. Keep a calm legible emergency-response feeling: warm inhabited miniature town, trustworthy evidence, clear next action, visible crews. No military aesthetic, holograms, sci-fi neon, flashy mobile-game buttons, excessive bloom or watermark.
